items.title: A Tale of Two Dollars: Why Dollar General Outpaced Dollar Tree This Quarter

items.title: Our e.l.f. Beauty Stock Pick Had an Ugly Year. Better Days Lie Ahead.
items.summary: Beauty  stock took a hard hit shortly after we published our initial recommendation, but the company has flipped the bearish narrative on the business.  The main pressure point: management’s 2026 sales growth guidance, issued in November of 2025, called for low single digit year over year organic sales growth, which excludes the effect of acquisitions.  Overall growth guidance was higher, given that the acquisition of rhode, Hailey Bieber’s brand, closed.

items.title: Cramer Says Costco at 49 Times Earnings Is the Mistake Loyal Shoppers Keep Making
items.summary: Jim Cramer is sounding an alarm about a beloved retailer that loyal shoppers treat as bulletproof, and the numbers behind his warning point toward a corner of retail that most investors still underestimate.
